strangerHistory.say: At sea the Grey Tithe take a tenth of every hold. Overlook pays nothing.
Three ports still stand. The rest are ruins, grown over with something nobody names.

tourSmiths.say: Steel that fits, for whoever walks in.
The smiths. You came ashore with nothing, so start with them.
Plain pieces cost little here. Better ones come and go.

tourMage.say: The Mage reads what the sea gives up.
Bring me what you find. Most of it is worth knowing.

tourVault.say: The Vault keeps what you cannot carry while you sail.
Nothing leaves my vault but with the one who left it.

tourTailor.say: The Tailor dyes what you wear.
Nobody should meet the Tithe looking drab.

tourTack.say: The Tack sells horses, and the barding to dress them.
The Bay is always in my stable. The others come and go.

tourPost.say: Letters written to you wait with the Postmaster.
I keep them until you come for them.

tourHarbour.say: Down at the harbour the Shipwright keeps a ship sound.
Bring your ship in, and she goes out sound.

tourHall.say: The Hall of the Arts. Stormcallers, Lamplighters and the Veiled each keep a chapel.
Hear all three before you give your word to one.
We keep the lamps lit, whoever you choose.

strangerFarewell.say: Here. Four hundred Aurem. Enough to stand up in.
I wish you well. My own road goes on from here.
